rules.name: Auto-approve small new claims when no fraud alert is open

$note: The WHOLE thing you write — nodejs-native, no package/FQN/DRL syntax. Read each `when` entry as a sentence: rule 1 = 'match a Claim (call it `claim`) whose amount > 100000'. `as` names the match so `then` can act on it: `as:"claim"` in when -> `set:"claim"` in then. Rule 2 shows a NEGATIVE match: `"exists": false` = 'there is NO FraudAlert that is open'. `where` is `{ field: value }` (equals) or `{ field: { op: value } }` (op = gt/gte/lt/lte/ne/in/contains/matches). `types` are the fact schemas; `fact` names one and the `where`/`set` field names are its fields. fromEngineProject synthesizes the .drl (imports, ruleflow-group, modify(), packages). See scenarios.md §0; model.json is the jBPM-side DrlModel this produces.
